special_attacks.monster_message: The Siren calls to you!

name: Chimera
description: A fearsome beast bearing the heads of both a lion and a goat while its tail takes the form of a giant snake. The chimera’s features so distinguish it from the natural world that it is believed by most to be born not of God’s power but of the sorcerer’s arts..

name: Dragon Monk Doomsayer
description: An exiled member of the dragon monks due to his prophetic visions, though his predictions ended up coming true. Uses forbidden dragon summoning techniques

special_attacks.monster_message: The dragon monk doomsayer calls forth a dragon!

name: Dragon Monk Avatar
description: This is an appointed member of the dragon-cult that acts as the emmissary between dragons and humans. As their leader, he is extremely powerful.

special_attacks.monster_message: The dragon monk avatar calls disciples to his aid!

name: Dragon Monk Disciple
description: A member of a draconic deathcult, they have forbidden the use of weapons in combat, representing the raw nature of a dragon's destructive presence. Even this lowly initiate is a formiddable foe

special_attacks.monster_message: The dragon monk hits you with a stunning blow!

name: Loot Hoarder Hobgoblin
description: A grimey, slimey, green-skinned, gold-snatching gremlin. It won't steal YOUR gold... but the gold it has is definitely stolen.

name: Goldsnatch Bokoblin
description: A grimey, slimey, green-skinned, gold-snatching gremlin. It won't steal YOUR gold... but the gold it has is definitely stolen.

name: Saurian
description: A large reptilian creature equipped with a makeshift spear mainly used for hunting fish.

special_attacks.monster_message: Wraiths spring forth from the void!

name: Wraithling
description: A magical flying demon, often seen in folklore as a symbol of vengeance or greed, though in reality this lowly creature only seeks death and destruction.
Kunai at the ready to pierce that which isn't part of the clan.

name: Hammeroblin
description: This small creature tosses hammers from a small pouch strapped to it's back, and if it's close to you it may whack you with tremendous force.

special_attacks.description: The hammeroblin hurls a mallet!

name: Goblin Wizard
description: A crafty goblin with the ability to use magic, it's kind likes to stay behind and buff it's allies.

special_attacks.monster_message: The goblin casts a spell!

name: Wraithlord
description: A flying demon with the ability to summon void rifts and call his minions from them, it's ghoulish presence chills to the bone.

special_attacks.monster_message: The wraithlord tears open a rift in reality!

name: Abductor Demon
description: A magical flying creature that is said to appear in the night and kidnap unsuspecting humans.

name: Melusine's Serpent
description: A serpent, capable of spitting acid and has a poisonous bite.

name: Doublizard
description: A two-headed serpent, capable of shooting flames and has a poisonous bite.

name: Crescent Drake
description: A lesser dragon with moonlit scales, circling on leathery wings. It rains down gouts of flame before closing in with tooth and claw.

name: Living Statue
description: A carved stone sentinel that grinds to life to defend its ground. Its thick hide turns aside nearly any blow, though it does not take much to shatter the fragile core that animates it.
Shards of killing ice, flung by an unseen will.

name: Blue Moon Sorceress
description: A wizard singing a faint song, riding on a crescent moon that shoots out icy spikes.

special_attacks.description: The wanderer flings a shard of killing ice!

special_attacks.monster_message: The wanderer conjures a shard of killing moonlight!

description: A gout of white-hot flame that leaves a trail of fire burning in its wake.

name: Ifrit
description: A towering, horned devil wreathed in living flame. The air itself seems to catch fire in its presence.

special_attacks.description: Ifrit breathes a searing stream of fire!

special_attacks.monster_message: Ifrit's flames roar to life!

name: Vilewing Runewhelp
description: A magical flying construct made from enchanted runes, powered by a special crystal.

name: Voidwing Runewhelp
description: A magical flying construct made from enchanted runes, powered by a special crystal.

name: Bloodwing Runewhelp
description: A magical flying construct made from enchanted runes, powered by a special crystal.

name: Shockwing Runewhelp
description: A magical flying construct made from enchanted runes, powered by a special crystal.

name: Delta Bug
description: A gigantic bug eminating huge tendrils of electricity from the top point on it's pyramidal shell.

name: Bomb
description: A spherical cloud of magical flames, held in a perpetual explosion until the creature decides to unleash it's energy and explode itself.

name: Bolide Runeshark
description: A magical runic creature somehow able to shift in and out of objects.

name: Abyss Snake
description: A creature made from living shadows, it's bite causes fear.

name: Toad Shaman
description: A gigantic toad practiced in the ways of casting magic.

name: Leech Warlock
description: A large flying leech, it controls 2 mindless worm drones and the leech itself is a drone serving a greater worm-god

special_attacks.monster_message: The leech absorbs life energy from the area!

name: Penguin Sorcerer
description: A large penguin, capable of casting frost magic

special_attacks.monster_message: Cold fog surrounds the area!

name: Worm wizard
description: A highly intelligent species of telepathic worm. Slimy and aggressive

special_attacks.monster_message: Worms emerge from the ground!

name: Shadow Seer
description: Your eyes meet a menacing gaze hidden behind writhing magical shadows, spreading darkness wherever it looks.

special_attacks.monster_message: Shadows cloud your mind

name: Shark Dash
description: gunbreaker dash spell.

name: Wolf Dash
description: gunbreaker dash spell.

name: Slug Druid
description: A highly intelligent species of spellcasting-slug, and a guardian of nature.

special_attacks.monster_message: A demonic effigy appears!

description: A desperate, body-breaking invocation that tears a rift into the infernal court, dragging forth whichever monster answers first. Every casting exacts a brutal toll on the caster's own flesh.
//: level 20 will max out your number of summons
//2: one minute cast time; the HP energy cost is what eventually kills the caster

name: Aging Warlock
description: A withered old spellcaster whose body is failing him. He has one last forbidden rite left in him, and he intends to use it.

special_attacks.monster_message: The Aging Warlock claws open a rift into the infernal court!

name: Elder Warlock
description: A more seasoned practitioner of the forbidden rites. He can weather the toll of a single casting, but a second will surely finish him.

special_attacks.monster_message: The Elder Warlock tears open a rift into the infernal court!

name: Atomos
description: The Atomos Gate. A colossal, self-cannibalizing rift given a semblance of shape, endlessly tearing itself apart to disgorge the infernal court's worst onto the world.

special_attacks.monster_message: The Atomos Gate tears itself open to disgorge another horror!

description: A short gout of fire washes over anything standing in front of the caster.

name: Lantern Goblin
description: A small, hunched goblin dragging along a guttering lantern of unnatural flame. It occasionally works itself up enough to spit fire from its own hands.

special_attacks.monster_message: The Lantern Goblin raises its lantern!

description: A writhing, unseen tentacle lashes out from the darkness to crush and rend.

name: Screaming Skull
description: A skull wreathed in ragged shreds of ectoplasm, drifting through the air on nothing at all. It shrieks to call others to your position, lashes out with grasping tentacles, and its bite carries a foul, corrupting rot.

special_attacks.monster_message: A tentacle lashes out from the Screaming Skull!

name: Adamantoise
description: A titanic tortoise whose shell has weathered ages beyond counting. It moves slowly and does not chase, but nothing short of an army can crack its hide.

name: Alpha Wampa
description: A hulking, shaggy predator that closes distance in a heartbeat, leaping from cover to cover before it ever lets you see it coming.
A volley of bone-hard needles launched from the quills along the basilisk's back.
A slitted, reptilian stare that locks the target's muscles rigid for a moment.

name: Basilisk
description: A large reptilian creature bristling with hardened quills along its spine, capable of launching them at anything that strays too close.

special_attacks.description: The Basilisk launches a volley of needles from its spine!

special_attacks.monster_message: The Basilisk fixes its gaze upon you!

description: A barbed, needle-sharp quill pulled from a basilisk's spine, its tip still slick with venom. Far more dangerous than a senbon.
Call forth goblins to your aid
Call forth goblins to your aid
Calls a goblin warband rushing in to answer the call, sometimes with a bokoblin or hammeroblin in tow.

name: Potoblin
description: A bloated, pot-bellied goblin caster that never strays from its hoard, chanting up other goblins to do its fighting for it.

special_attacks.monster_message: The potoblin cackles and slams its ladle, summoning more goblins!

description: A massive polearm with a broad, curved axe blade mounted on each end. Wielding it takes real strength, but it strikes with the momentum of a wrecking ball.

name: Doublax Devil
description: A towering brute of a demon that never lets go of its namesake weapon - a gigantic polearm with a broad axe head mounted on both ends. It closes distance fast and swings with earth-shaking force.

A human-shaped figure clad in special-ops gear, moving with a speed and precision no human body could survive. Its predator eyes hunt for more lucrative prey, and whatever hears its distress beacon answers hungry for a fight.

special_attacks.description: The predator demon goes to one knee, takes aim, and fires their gun in a burst that shreds cover.

use_action.friendly_msg: The beacon crackles to life... something answers the call.
use_action.hostile_msg: The beacon shrieks with feedback - whatever heard that is NOT friendly.

description: A cracked, palm-sized comms beacon salvaged from a mercenary outpost.  It still hums faintly on a frequency no sane person should answer.  Activating it summons whatever - or whoever - is listening.
A crackling bolt of raw lightning that leaves the air smelling of ozone in its wake.

name: Ramuh
description: An ancient, robed devil crackling with barely-contained lightning. Thunder rolls whenever it so much as stirs.

special_attacks.description: Ramuh hurls a crackling bolt of lightning!

special_attacks.monster_message: Ramuh calls down the storm!

name: Golden Gargoyle
description: A gargoyle cast in solid gold, gleaming even in pitch dark. It moves ponderously, but its golden hide has crushed stronger things than steel.

name: Gargoyle
description: A hunched, stone-winged sentinel etched with fading runes. It watches from rooftops until something worth crushing wanders too close.

name: Cockatrice
description: A vile hybrid of serpent and fowl, spitting venom and acid in every direction. Its gaze alone is said to curdle blood.
A biting blast of glacial cold that frosts everything it touches.

name: Shiva
description: An ancient, frost-veiled devil whose breath alone can freeze flesh solid. The air chills whenever it draws near.

special_attacks.description: Shiva exhales a biting blast of frost!

special_attacks.monster_message: Shiva's frost gathers into a killing chill!

description: Call forth Shadow's loyal hound.

name: Shadow's Loyal Hound
description: A spirit-hound, the eternal soul-linked companion of Shadow.

name: Shadow, Blood Blade Assassin
description: A legendary assassin cloaked in shifting shadow, said to strike a hundred times before the first wound is even felt.

special_attacks.description: Shadow throws a crystal kunai!

special_attacks.monster_message: Shadow dashes away and clouds himself in smoke!
Shadow whistles sharply, calling his hound to his side!

//: PLACEHOLDER - user will fill this with the mod's actual modded magic sword items later

description: A blade-strike too fast to see, cutting clean through devil hide.

name: Sword Saint
description: A masterless swordsman of impossible skill, hunting devils for a sin only he remembers. His blade never misses twice.

special_attacks.monster_message: The Sword Saint's blade flashes in a blur of motion!

name: Red-Eyes Black Dragon
description: A dragon of pure malice, its crimson eyes burning with hatred. Its fangs drip a venom that rots flesh from the inside out.

special_attacks.monster_message: Red-Eyes Black Dragon opens its maw and breathes a cone of fire!
